title: How to Prompt AI Effectively: The Six-Layer Method, Explained Simply
lede: 'How to prompt AI effectively' is one of the highest-volume question searches — this is our most requested topic, answered with the same six-layer method behind every guide on this site.
body_md:
## The one-sentence answer
Effective prompting is not about magic words — it is about giving the model **six pieces of information in a stable order**: subject, outfit, pose, scene, light, medium.

## Why order matters
Models read prompts as language, not as a bag of keywords. Put the medium first and the model treats it as the subject. Our 60 experiments confirmed the six-layer order produces the most stable results.

## A worked example
Weak: `beautiful fashion photo, masterpiece, 8k`
Strong: `a young woman in a camel wool coat / walking on a city street / looking back / dusk / warm street lamp light / street style photography, 35mm`
The strong version says nothing about quality — because quality words do nothing. It says everything about what should be in the image.

## The three habits that matter
1. Name observable things, not adjectives ('rim light on hair', not 'beautiful').
2. Change one variable at a time so you learn what works.
3. Write your criterion before generating — 'is the collar direction correct?' beats 'do I like it?'.

## Go deeper
This is the short answer. Our Fashion AI Prompt Grammar, 20 Failure Modes, and Prompt Lab Method are the full curriculum.
